h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturers & Suppliers in Bathinda

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturers & Suppliers in Bathinda

items.pText: Bathinda in the Malwa region of Punjab has a refinery, a thermal power plant, a large cantonment and a cotton-growing hinterland. Several of these employers run housing colonies and schools for their staff, and each colony usually has a park or two. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for these townships, and for private schools and societies in Bathinda, at our Vasai factory about 1,220 km away.

Malwa summers are very hot, and dust blows in from the dry fields before the monsoon. Winters are cold, with foggy mornings in December and January. Galvanised steel posts and roto-moulded plastic slides and panels handle that range without rusting or cracking. Township parks also see long hours of use, so we suggest equipment that many children can share, and a layout that leaves clear walking paths for parents and older residents.

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can you supply several parks in one township?
items.a: Yes. Share the size and photos of each park and we will prepare a separate layout for each. You can approve them together and we dispatch the equipment as one order.

items.q: How do we keep playground equipment clean in dusty months?
items.a: Wipe slides and seats with water and a soft cloth, and sweep the rubber flooring. Avoid harsh chemicals or wire brushes on roto-moulded parts, as they scratch the surface.

items.q: Do you install playground equipment in Bathinda?
items.a: Yes. We send the equipment from our Vasai factory by road and install it with our team or a dealer serving Punjab, grouted or self-standing.
